what: Industrial Road closed for flooding between Harbor Boulevard and Quarry Road, 11:43 AM to 2:46 PM.

King tides and large waves (NWS High Surf Warning, breakers of 20 to 30 ft) broke the L-shaped end off the Pacifica Municipal Pier, closed since June 4 for cracks. The beach and water near the pier were closed; beachfront homes flooded.
source: City of Pacifica Public Safety Advisory; AP

what: After overnight storm response, the city filled voids in the Beach Boulevard seawall. Seawall sections, the beach and the water near the pier stayed closed.
source: City of Pacifica Public Safety Advisory
